tasks.title: Restructure built-in skill assets into stubs and skill-data
tasks.description: Reorganize `packages/cli/src/agent-skills/` so Mohist-managed skills have separate discovery stubs and full packaged content. Move the current full markdown guidance into `skill-data/<name>/SKILL.md`, place supplementary files under the skill-data tree, and add short `hidden: true` stub `SKILL.md` files that direct agents to `mo skills get`.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/cli/src/agent-skills/skill-data/mohist/SKILL.md` contains the current full mohist guidance content
`packages/cli/src/agent-skills/skill-data/mohist/references/issue-templates.md` exists and preserves the current supplementary reference content
`packages/cli/src/agent-skills/skill-data/mohist-explore/SKILL.md` contains the current full mohist-explore guidance content
Each built-in stub `SKILL.md` includes frontmatter with `name`, `description`, and `hidden: true` plus guidance to use `mo skills get`
No user-authored repository skill such as `.agents/skills/mohist-po/` is introduced into the built-in asset set
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Deliver the new source-of-truth asset layout first so later resolver, installer, and packaging work can read a stable directory structure.

tasks.title: Implement packaged skill discovery and CLI read commands
tasks.description: Add a local built-in skill resolver that locates packaged assets through `MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR`, packaged `dist/agent-skills`, or source layout, then scans stubs and skill-data with deterministic deduplication. Use that resolver to extend `mo skills` with `list`, `get`, and `path`, including `--full`, `--all`, and `--json`, so the CLI always serves version-matched built-in content instead of repository copies.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo skills list` returns the visible built-in Mohist skills sorted by name and does not surface hidden discovery stubs as duplicate entries
`mo skills list --json` returns structured JSON including skill name, description, hidden flag, and resolved source path or equivalent metadata
`mo skills get mohist` prints the full packaged `skill-data/mohist/SKILL.md` content rather than the installed stub text
`mo skills get mohist --full` appends supplementary files from `references/` and `templates/` in deterministic sorted order
`mo skills get --all` returns the built-in visible skill set backed by packaged full content
`mo skills path mohist` prints the packaged directory path used for the built-in mohist skill
Setting `MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR` to a valid asset root overrides default packaged/source lookup
The `skills` command group remains local and does not require the Mohist server to be running
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes the asset layout from T-001 and should keep built-in read behavior separate from `.mohist/skills` runtime logic.

tasks.title: Switch skill installation and packaging to stub-only distribution
tasks.description: Refactor shared skill installation so Mohist-managed repository installs write only stub `SKILL.md` files into `.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`, while preserving compatibility with preexisting full installed skills by overwriting only the managed built-in names on reinstall. Update backend build packaging so the new `stubs/` and `skill-data/` directories are copied into `dist/agent-skills/` and shipped with the CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo skills install` writes only lightweight stub `SKILL.md` files for `mohist` and `mohist-explore` and no longer copies full guidance or `issue-templates.md` into repository skill directories
Installed stubs are under 50 lines and include `hidden: true` in frontmatter
Re-running `mo skills install` upgrades an existing Mohist-managed full installed skill to the current stub content for the same built-in name
Installing shared skills does not modify unrelated user-authored skill directories such as `.agents/skills/mohist-po/`
`packages/cli/package.json` build scripts copy `stubs/` and `skill-data/` into `dist/agent-skills/` so packaged CLI installs can resolve built-in assets
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 for the new asset layout and T-002 for the shared built-in resolver so install and read paths use one source of truth.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage for dynamic skill loading and compatibility
tasks.description: Add focused automated coverage for packaged skill discovery, JSON and text CLI output, stub-only install behavior, environment override lookup, and compatibility with repositories that still contain old full installed skills. The regression suite should verify that dynamic reads stay version-matched to packaged assets while repository-local user skills remain untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover `mo skills list`, `list --json`, `get`, `get --full`, `get --all`, and `path` against the built-in packaged asset layout
Tests cover `MOHIST_SKILLS_DIR` overriding default skill asset discovery
Tests cover stub-only install output for `mohist` and `mohist-explore` and verify no supplementary files are copied into repository skill directories
Tests cover compatibility with preexisting full installed Mohist skill files by confirming built-in `get` still serves packaged content and reinstall converts managed names to stubs
Tests cover that unrelated user-authored skill directories remain untouched during install
Relevant test suite passes
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use temporary directories and fixture asset roots so packaged-path, source-path, and compatibility behaviors can all be verified without mutating repository-owned skills.
